headline: Holcim Upgrades 2026 Earnings Forecast Following Solid Q3 Sales Growth
summary: Building materials giant Holcim lifted its full-year 2026 earnings guidance on the back of strong third-quarter sales volume.
why: Holcim is one of the world's largest cement and building solution suppliers, serving as an indicator of global infrastructure and construction activity.

impacts.name: Holcim Ltd
impacts.why: Upgraded full-year guidance signals stronger cash flow and earnings momentum.
